A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities so the fractional parts are in a directly comparable form, such as finding a common denominator or expressing a whole number with a matching fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to match the denominator used in subtraction.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag for simplifying a fraction after subtraction.
Do not tag for normalizing an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 5/3 is rewritten as an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states that a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding common denominators or equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping during subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract the relevant whole-number parts and/or fractional numerators once the quantities are already aligned for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers without borrowing.
Tag when the solution combines the already-subtracted whole and fractional results into the final mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for creating common denominators or rewriting whole numbers to match denominators.
Do not tag for converting improper mixed numbers to standard mixed numbers.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping when the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag for reducing a nonfinal fraction to lowest terms.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution shows a negative fractional difference and then borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into n/n and added to the existing fractional part before subtracting.
Tag when borrowing is used in mixed-number subtraction or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed without regrouping.
Do not tag for merely subtracting aligned parts after borrowing has already been set up; that subtraction itself belongs to S03.
Do not tag for simplifying the final answer.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions so they can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction within pure fractions or mixed-number fraction parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for simplifying a fraction after subtraction.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over an existing denominator unless no denominator conversion occurs.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible standard form before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number or as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when the setup changes operand form so whole and fractional parts can be aligned for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for borrowing during subtraction after the initial setup.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator between unlike fractions.
Do not tag when the operands are already in usable form and no rewriting occurs.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction is carried out after normalization or denominator equalization, including intermediate negative fractional results before borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the preparatory rewriting of operands into standard form.
Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping from the whole part to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for final simplification such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4 or converting 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Borrow from the whole part when needed and express the final difference in lowest terms or integer/mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is regrouped as denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when a negative fractional part triggers borrowing or regrouping.
Tag when the result is reduced to lowest terms, converted from a zero fraction to an integer, or combined into final mixed-number form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for ordinary subtraction that does not require borrowing and does not include simplification beyond direct statement of the result.
Do not tag for finding common denominators.
Do not tag for initial operand normalization such as rewriting a whole number as 3 + 0/5.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, denominator alignment, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite fractional quantities into a compatible form for subtraction by finding a common denominator or expressing a whole number with a fractional part of the needed denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a stated denominator to match the fractional part in subtraction.
Tag when denominator alignment is explicitly performed before subtracting fraction parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when fractions already share a denominator and no rewriting is needed.
Do not tag for simplifying a fraction such as 4/10 to 2/5; that is not denominator alignment for subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Normalize or simplify terms
skills.definition: Rewrite a given number into an equivalent simpler standard form before subtraction, such as converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part to a proper mixed number or reducing a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a fractional part is simplified before subtraction, such as 4/10 to 2/5.
Tag when the step explicitly rewrites one operand into an equivalent cleaner form prior to the main subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator between unlike fractions; that belongs to denominator alignment.
Do not tag for simplifying the final answer after subtraction unless the simplification is clearly part of rewriting an operand before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once forms are compatible, including subtracting numerators of like-denominator fractions and subtracting whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the subtraction step produces an intermediate negative fractional part that may later require borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the preparatory rewriting needed to make forms compatible.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping itself.
Do not tag for final reduction such as turning 9/12 into 3/4.

skills.name: Regroup and finalize
skills.definition: Resolve subtraction results by borrowing/regrouping when needed and expressing the final result in simplest valid form, including reducing fractions or writing 0 or an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 is borrowed from the whole part and converted into fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when the result is simplified after subtraction, such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for initial normalization of an operand before subtraction.
Do not tag for merely performing the raw subtraction of aligned parts without regrouping or final-form processing.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator.
